precepts.text: Cited as the little sanctuaries the Lord provides in the countries where Israel is scattered, the same as the schools today.
precepts.point: Any task set before our forefathers got done: the Maccabees who were not warriors, the slaves who left Egypt. Egypt was America. If the shooting starts, we know scripturally what happens; the Lord takes care of it.

note.label: Mindset Of A Leader, Actions Of A King

precepts.why:
“So built we the wall”: all through our history, the forefathers were building. What we are doing today is nothing different from what they always did, and Ezekiel shows the kind of building the Lord gives us while we are scattered.

“Although I have cast them far off among the heathen, and although I have scattered them among the countries, yet will I be to them as a little sanctuary in the countries where they shall come.” Israel was cast far off and scattered, and the Lord still gave them little sanctuaries in the lands where they came.

When Paul went to Galatia, to Colossae, to Corinth and to Thessalonica, those were sanctuaries, just like the ones you see today. The schools are those little sanctuaries in the countries, and each and every one of us put a hand into building each and every one of them.

So the wall of Nehemiah and the little sanctuary of Ezekiel are the same work. The people built because they had a mind to work, and that mind to work is what leadership has to put into the people now.

precepts.text: If thine eye be single, thy whole body shall be full of light. A leader is locked in with laser focus, and everybody under him becomes the same.
precepts.point: Any task set before our forefathers got done: the Maccabees who were not warriors, the slaves who left Egypt. Egypt was America. If the shooting starts, we know scripturally what happens; the Lord takes care of it.

note.label: Mindset Of A Leader, Actions Of A King

precepts.why:
The people built the wall because they “had a mind to work.” This is how a leader’s mindset must be, and Christ shows it: “The light of the body is the eye: if therefore thine eye be single, thy whole body shall be full of light.”

A single eye is being locked in, what they call laser focus. Whatever you are locked in on, that is what you are going to see. That is all you are going to see, and that is all that matters.

And when the leader is like that, guess who else is going to be like that? Everybody underneath him. The single eye of the one at the head fills the whole body with light, so the whole camp takes on his focus.

That is why the wall got built. The mind to work in the people starts with the mind of the one leading them.

precepts.text: A wise judge will instruct his people; as the judge of the people is himself, so are his officers. Disorganized camps that talk about rape and build nothing reflect their leaders. When we go to Chicago we are on O'Block teaching, not filmed eating chicken and pizza in the hood at midnight.

note.label: Mindset Of A Leader, Actions Of A King

precepts.why:
“A wise judge will instruct his people; and the government of a prudent man is well ordered. As the judge of the people is himself, so are his officers; and what manner of man the ruler of the city is, such are all they that dwell therein.” However the leader is, that is how the men under him are going to be.

So when you see these other camps that look disorganized, that are talking about rape, that have not built anything in years, find their leaders, and that is what you will see. When you see us traveling all over the world, building institutions, organizations within the organization, look at our leaders. We are the representation of our leadership.

When we go to Chicago we are not on film eating chicken and pizza in the hood at midnight. How is that a leader of a congregation? You will never see a bishop or a deacon put out a video like that. When we went to Chicago, we went to O’Block teaching the word of the Lord.

Everything rises and falls on leadership. There are cities where the leader was changed and the camp took off, and other places where the leader left and everything fell apart. You are who your leader is. That is why everybody wants to ask the Bishop for the secret sauce, but what they do not understand is that Christ is at the head and we are all following Christ. The Most High is building 144,000 leaders, sealed with the law of God, and nothing they try can stop it.

That is why the people of Nehemiah had a mind to work: the wall reflects the ones leading the building.

precepts.text: Nehemiah answers the mockery with prayer, asking the Most High to turn the enemies' reproach upon their own heads.
precepts.point: This is the pattern for Israel United in Christ today, a people with a mind to work who understand the condition of their people and the mission to rebuild their minds.

note.label: Nehemiah 4: Building With a Weapon in Hand

precepts.why:
Before the wall was joined together to half its height, the builders were mocked, and Nehemiah answered the mockery with prayer: “Hear, O our God; for we are despised: and turn their reproach upon their own head, and give them for a prey in the land of captivity”.

He did not answer the enemies in their own coin; he asked the Most High to turn their reproach upon their own heads. Then “So built we the wall”, and it went up “for the people had a mind to work.” That is the pattern for Israel United in Christ today: a people who pray against the reproach and keep building, with a mind to work, understanding the condition of their people and the mission to rebuild their minds.

precepts.point: Their whole plan is to cause the work to cease and keep the city from being rebuilt.

note.label: Nehemiah 4: Building With a Weapon in Hand

precepts.why:
The enemies “conspired all of them together to come and to fight against Jerusalem, and to hinder it.” Their whole plan was to cause the work to cease and keep the city from being rebuilt. The builders' answer was twofold: “Nevertheless we made our prayer unto our God, and set a watch against them day and night, because of them.”

Prayer to the Most High, and a watch set day and night. They did not stop building and they did not only pray; they prayed and they watched, because of the ones conspiring against them. That is how the conspiracy to hinder the work was met.

precepts.why:
It is the same thing back in chapter 4: “And our adversaries said, They shall not know, neither see, till we come in the midst among them, and slay them, and cause the work to cease.”

That is the whole point: they want to come in among us, destroy us and cause the work to cease. That was the whole purpose of integration. Back then we had a sense of unity and purpose and understood who the enemy was, and they understood that if the commandments of God came in, it would be a detriment to them. So they broke it all up, because they want the work to cease.

points: When the enemies' counsel was brought to nought, all returned to the wall, everyone unto his work. Half wrought in the work and half held the spears, shields, and bows.

note.label: Mindset Of A Leader, Actions Of A King

points: Everyone with one hand wrought in the work and with the other held a weapon. That is us: nine hours at the job, then the camp or the flyer mission, part-time prophets fighting two battles, and some a third at home.

note.label: Mindset Of A Leader, Actions Of A King

points: Be not afraid of them: remember the Lord, and fight for your brethren, your sons, your daughters, your wives and your houses.
That is the charge — the man standing for what is right and holding up the laws of God.

note.label: Radicalize The Youth

points: When Sanballat hears that the wall is being built he is wroth, takes great indignation, and mocks the Jews.
One of the heathen rulers rises up against the work, treating the rebuilding of Jerusalem as something to be scorned.

note.label: Nehemiah 4: Building With a Weapon in Hand

points: Before his brethren and the army of Samaria, Sanballat mocks the feeble Jews, asking if they will fortify themselves, sacrifice, finish in a day, and revive the burned stones out of the heaps of rubbish.
He makes his mockery in front of his army, calling the people weak, the same way the heathen today mock the men who go out in one mind to do the work of the Most High.

note.label: Nehemiah 4: Building With a Weapon in Hand

points: Tobiah the Ammonite stands by him and says that even what they build, if a fox go up on it, would break down their stone wall.
The enemy despises the work as flimsy, but the builders answer by praying that their reproach be turned upon their own head.

note.label: Nehemiah 4: Building With a Weapon in Hand

points: The wall is joined together to half its height, for the people had a mind to work.
This is the pattern for Israel United in Christ today, a people with a mind to work who understand the condition of their people and the mission to rebuild their minds.

note.label: Nehemiah 4: Building With a Weapon in Hand

points: When Sanballat, Tobiah, the Arabians, the Ammonites, and the Ashdodites hear that the walls are going up and the breaches are being stopped, they are very wroth.
The breaches are the weaker places the enemies expected would fail. When they hear those gaps are fortified, their anger rises because their expectation of failure is broken.

note.label: Nehemiah 4: Building With a Weapon in Hand

points: They conspire together to come and fight against Jerusalem and to hinder the work.
Their whole plan is to cause the work to cease and keep the city from being rebuilt.

note.label: Nehemiah 4: Building With a Weapon in Hand

points: Judah says the strength of the bearers of burdens is decayed, there is much rubbish, and they are not able to build the wall.
Even among the workers the burden grows heavy and discouragement sets in as the enemy pressure mounts.

note.label: Nehemiah 4: Building With a Weapon in Hand

points: The adversaries say they will not be known or seen until they come into the midst and slay them and cause the work to cease.
The enemies plot a surprise attack, aiming to kill the builders and stop the work entirely.

note.label: Nehemiah 4: Building With a Weapon in Hand

points: Nehemiah sets the people in the lower and higher places behind the wall after their families with their swords, spears, and bows.
He arms the people by family and posts them at the exposed places, ready to defend the work.

note.label: Nehemiah 4: Building With a Weapon in Hand

points: Nehemiah tells the nobles, rulers, and people not to be afraid but to remember the Lord, who is great and terrible, and to fight for their brethren, sons, daughters, wives, and houses.
The answer to fear is to remember the greatness of the Most High and to fight for the family and the people.

note.label: Nehemiah 4: Building With a Weapon in Hand

points: From that time half of the servants work while the other half hold the spears, shields, and bows, and the rulers stand behind all of Judah.
The people labor and guard at the same time, knowing the enemies are plotting against the rebuilding.

note.label: Nehemiah 4: Building With a Weapon in Hand

points: Those who bear burdens work with one hand and hold a weapon with the other.
Every builder keeps a weapon ready even while laying the wall, watchful against attack.

note.label: Nehemiah 4: Building With a Weapon in Hand

points: Every builder has his sword girded by his side as he builds, and the one who sounds the trumpet stays by Nehemiah.
The trumpet becomes the signal to gather, keeping the scattered workers ready to unite at the point of attack.

note.label: Nehemiah 4: Building With a Weapon in Hand

points: Nehemiah tells the people that the work is great and large and they are separated far from one another along the wall.
Because the builders are spread out, they need a plan to come together quickly if the enemy strikes.

note.label: Nehemiah 4: Building With a Weapon in Hand

points: Wherever they hear the sound of the trumpet, they are to resort there, for the Most High shall fight for them.
The confidence of the builders rests on the truth that their God fights for them.

note.label: Nehemiah 4: Building With a Weapon in Hand

points: They labor in the work, half of them holding the spears from the rising of the morning until the stars appear.
The people work from dawn to nightfall, giving the full day to the task.

note.label: Nehemiah 4: Building With a Weapon in Hand

points: Neither Nehemiah, his brethren, his servants, nor the men of the guard put off their clothes, saving only for washing.

They are so serious about the work and so watchful that they stay dressed and ready at all times, of one mind to finish the wall, the same way the people are to be of one mind and one spirit today in the resurrection of the people.

note.label: Nehemiah 4: Building With a Weapon in Hand

points: “When Sanballat heard that we builded the wall, he was wroth, and took great indignation, and mocked the Jews.” Sanballat is our enemy, just to make it simple. Just as he got mad when we built, our enemies today see that we are trying to build and they get mad, wroth just like the dragon, with great wrath and indignation, mocking us.

note.label: THE REBIRTH OF GOD’S NATION ON THE EARTH

points: “What do these feeble Jews? will they fortify themselves?” Look how they talk about us: these feeble Israelites. Will the Lord actually fortify them? Will the Lord actually be with them? That mockery is the kind of talk that will break your confidence down if you listen to it. Sometimes the foolishness comes from BHIs, black people with fringes on, saying something that gets your mind all twisted up. Recognize what you are dealing with, move them out of your way and keep moving forward. We have no hatred for any of them, and hope they repent and get right, but we are not playing games with anybody out here promoting foolishness.

“Will they revive the stones out of the heaps of the rubbish which are burned?” The Babylonians had literally burned our temple and destroyed everything. Will these feeble Israelites rebuild the ruins? They are laughing at us.

note.label: THE REBIRTH OF GOD’S NATION ON THE EARTH

points: “If a fox go up, he shall even break down their stone wall.” They are saying we have no skills to build anything, and we end up carrying that and believing that we can’t do what the Lord said we can do. This is what our enemies say about us today.

note.label: THE REBIRTH OF GOD’S NATION ON THE EARTH

points: “Hear, O our God; for we are despised.” This is us making a prayer to the Lord. They are mad that we are being used as prophets and teachers, going out into the streets and all the avenues. Our job is to revive the souls of our people through the blood of Christ, through Israel United in Christ: to give them the breath, as with Adam, as in Ezekiel when the breath came into them and they lived. Our enemies don’t want that.

“Turn their reproach upon their own head, and give them for a prey in the land of captivity”: like when the brothers pray at the beginning of our classes for destruction upon our enemies. Deacon Malachi does it very heavily, and Captain Suriah; we are praying for vengeance. “And cover not their iniquity”: don’t hide what they did to us; bring it out. “For they have provoked thee to anger before the builders”: our job is to rebuild our nation, and that is what we are doing now.

note.label: THE REBIRTH OF GOD’S NATION ON THE EARTH

points: “So built we the wall; and all the wall was joined together unto the half thereof: for the people had a mind to work.” Not just sitting with faith in some corner: work, work, work. You only work for something you believe in. A woman on the table in labour: her faith is wanting to deliver that baby, and her work is the pushing. Faith without works is dead. You envisioned that child in your mind, counting the toes; now push.
Recognize the beauty that goes on when a man and a woman come together to produce a child. That is heavy, and nothing to be playing with.

note.label: THE REBIRTH OF GOD’S NATION ON THE EARTH

points: “When Sanballat, and Tobiah, and the Arabians, and the Ammonites, and the Ashdodites, heard that the walls of Jerusalem were made up”: brought up to date, they are mad that we got another school, that more people are repenting, that we get stronger every week. We did no harm to anybody. Just the fact that we are changing our evil ways into righteous ways is a threat to them, because they know once we repent God will be on our side and they will not be able to abuse us as they have.

“And that the breaches began to be stopped, then they were very wroth.” What are the breaches today? Sin. The first breach that must be stopped is the breach of sin, because that is what separates us from our God. All of us had to repent of our evil ways, and they don’t want us to repent. Thank goodness for Original Royalty, which had to step into that rap, crime and gangster life, the drill music and all that craziness, while Trump is sending the troops in to wipe them out. They know they have a short time left, so they say, just get rid of them.

The majority of our incidents deal with moral and civil violations against each other, primarily fornication and adultery, because of lust. Go not after your lust. This society makes it its permanent business to entice you with racy ads, videos and music, on your jobs and in your schools, and these things lead to the permanent destruction of our people.

So we set up a proving process for brothers and sisters, primarily the younger members: generally three years, as agreed with Deacon Yashua. It is not a biblical law (the elderly may not have three years), but it is respectable: a diligent search, so no skeletons come out as soon as you are married. You should not be driven to marry solely on lust. Marriage is where the real work and the real journey begin, and you are supposed to want to grow old with that person. No backdoor weddings. When it is done right, the bishops, deacons and captains can bless that marriage.

note.label: THE REBIRTH OF GOD’S NATION ON THE EARTH

points: “And conspired all of them together to come and to fight against Jerusalem, and to hinder it.” That is what our enemies want to do: give us all kinds of innuendos, lies and slander, anything to break the brotherhood and the sisterhood, to break the unity and dissolve the bands, and have us loose, wild and crazy, tied up in all types of evil.

We are attacked with every sinful temptation: lust, drugs, music, movies, anything to knock you off course. Much of it is designed to get inside the woman’s head so she does not think righteously about getting a husband: videos to get her all hot, when she does not know how to get a husband. That is not something negative about the woman; it is a slur against us as men. Where was your father, sister? Where were the men in your community? We have to take ownership. Even with Eve, the Lord did not let Adam off: it was that woman you gave me, and it was still Adam’s fault.

Look at how they hinder us. Pfizer sells Depo-Provera, a birth control injection every three months, with side effects of irregular bleeding, weight gain, headaches, mood changes and loss of bone density. Black women take it at nearly double the national rate, and women who took it are suing over brain tumours. The European Union added a warning in 2024 and Canada since 2006, but no such warning was given in the United States, knowing half its users were black women. Black people are supposed to be 13% of the population, yet black women use about half of this product. One woman took it for nearly 30 years, with no husband in sight, and ended up with a tumour on her brain. Pfizer says the FDA rejected its effort to warn patients; either way, they knew half their users were black women and told them nothing. And whether the drug is right or wrong, it should not even be in your vocabulary: no married couple should be dealing with this.

The FDA also quietly approved a second generic abortion pill just before the government shutdown, the way the abortion clinics stayed open, fully staffed, through the COVID shutdown while everything else closed and the COVID babies came. That is the thought planted in a simple woman: I can fornicate and not worry, take this drug or go to the abortionist and do it again. Nineteen million babies destroyed since ’73. The Lord calls that fornication. If you’re not married, keep your legs closed; get a husband. Why would a married woman be taking something like this? Many of the BHI sisters in these multiple-wife situations take it because the brother cannot take care of five or six of them.

In the hospitals our people come in wanting the pill to kill the baby, fighting on the maternity floor, while Esau goes to fertility clinics to have children, and the whole waiting room rejoices when the baby is born. One baby comes home to hatred and chaos, the other to a loving family.

Let every wife have her own husband and every husband his own wife: there is a man for every woman, whatever statistic they bring. The seven women of Isaiah 4 is for when we get out of here, because so many men will be killed in the war; it is no lust trip either. In captivity, deal with it with paperwork: you have papers on your car and your house, so get the papers that say you and your wife belong together.

These are real enemies. The book The Choice, on the issue of black survival in America, records research from October 1968, 1,176 interviews with a national sample of adult Americans, made for the National Commission on the Causes and Prevention of Violence for the Office of Naval Research: only 18% would protest, even nonviolently, the mass repression of American blacks, and only 9% would resist it. People don’t care about us, and that is why we have to deal with ourselves.

Now they speak of using the dangerous cities as training grounds for the military; Washington, D.C. was the testing ground for the rest. They are going into Chicago, and over 30,000 Ukrainian refugees have been brought into Chicago while they get rid of blacks out of it: that is ethnic cleansing. They are serious about what they are doing, and so we must build the wall, stop the breaches of sin, and keep the unity.

note.label: THE REBIRTH OF GOD’S NATION ON THE EARTH

points: “When Sanballat heard that we builded the wall, he was wroth, and took great indignation, and mocked the Jews.” He got mad because they built. Any time we come together as a nation and want to build something and stop the degeneracy in our neighborhoods, the other nations get mad and mock us, and sometimes they pay our own people to do it.

note.label: State of Decay

points: “What do these feeble Jews? will they fortify themselves?” Esau thought the same when he emancipated us: these feeble Jews. But we began to build, come among each other and unify, and we had a better economic system and more prosperous towns and cities than they did. This is the spirit of the other nations: they destroy us and then mock, are these feeble Jews going to build? “Will they make an end in a day? will they revive the stones out of the heaps of the rubbish which are burned?”

note.label: State of Decay

points: “Now Tobiah the Ammonite was by him, and he said, Even that which they build, if a fox go up, he shall even break down their stone wall.” Whatever they build a fox can break down; they will not come up out of that rubble without us. That is because Nehemiah had told them they had no portion nor right in Jerusalem.

note.label: State of Decay

points: “Hear, O our God; for we are despised”. To this day we are despised when we try to wake our people up out of their decayed state, rebuild the breach and change the minds of our people. “And turn their reproach upon their own head, and give them for a prey in the land of captivity”.

note.label: State of Decay
